# NAMI HelpLine FAQs

> > Comprehensive mental health support resources and frequently asked questions from the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI) HelpLine.

This site provides bilingual (English/Spanish) answers to common questions about mental health services, crisis intervention, treatment options, advocacy, and community support. NAMI HelpLine connects individuals, families, and caregivers with resources including SAMHSA, Indian Health Service, Medicare/Medicaid guidance, and specialized support for diverse communities.

## Key Topics

- NAMI HelpLine
- Crisis intervention and suicide prevention
- Bilingual mental health resources (Spanish/English)
- Indigenous and Native American mental health services
- LGBTQI mental health support
- Schizophrenia and bipolar disorder treatment
- Medicare and Medicaid services (CMS)
- SAMHSA resources
- Cultural competent care
- Peer support and community resources
- Mental health advocacy
- Legal rights and housing discrimination
- Sexual assault crisis services (RAINN)
- Chronic pain and dissociative disorders
- Employment and vocational rehabilitation

## Crisis Support & Safety

- [My loved one is having suicidal thoughts. What can I do?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/27-my-loved-one-is-having-suicidal-thoughts-what-can-i-do): Suicide prevention resources including 988 Lifeline and crisis intervention
- [I believe I/my loved one is being abused. What can I do to get help?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/23-i-believe-i-my-loved-one-is-being-abused-what-can-i-do-to-get-help): Abuse resources including child abuse hotlines and domestic violence support
- [Soy víctima de violación o agresión sexual. ¿Qué debo hacer? / I am a victim of rape/sexual assault. What do I do?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/389-soy-victima-de-violacion-o-agresion-sexual-que-debo-hacer-i-am-a-victim-of-rape-sexual-assault-what-do-i-do): Sexual assault crisis resources including RAINN hotline (bilingual)

## Treatment & Medication Resources

- [What are long-acting injectable medications? Will they help my loved one in their recovery?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/546-what-are-long-acting-injectable-medications-will-they-help-my-loved-one-in-their-recovery): Info on LAIs for schizophrenia and bipolar disorder treatment
- [Clozapine might be helpful for my loved one with schizophrenia. What do I need to know?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/547-clozapine-might-be-helpful-for-my-loved-one-with-schizophrenia-what-do-i-need-to-know): Clozapine medication guide for treatment-resistant schizophrenia
- [¿Cómo puedo encontrar un terapeuta que se adapte a mí? / How can I find a therapist who is a good fit for me?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/312-como-puedo-encontrar-un-terapeuta-que-se-adapte-a-mi): Guide to finding culturally competent therapists for BIPOC and LGBTQI (bilingual)
- [How can I get help/support for dissociative disorders?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/49-how-can-i-get-help-support-for-dissociative-disorders): Dissociative disorders support resources and trauma therapy referrals
- [I live with chronic pain. Are there any support groups that can help me?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/59-i-live-with-chronic-pain-are-there-any-support-groups-that-can-help-me): Chronic pain support groups including American Chronic Pain Association

## Community-Specific Resources

- [¿Existen recursos de salud mental específicos para la comunidad indígena/nativa? / Are there any mental health resources specifically for the Indigenous/Native community?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/343-existen-recursos-de-salud-mental-especificos-para-la-comunidad-indigena-nativa-are-there-any-mental-health-resources-specifically-for-the-indigenous-native-community): Mental health resources for Indigenous/Native American communities (bilingual)
- [¿Existen recursos de salud mental específicos para la comunidad LGBTQI? / Are there any mental health resources specifically for the LGBTQI community?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/344-existen-recursos-de-salud-mental-especificos-para-la-comunidad-lgbtqi-are-there-any-mental-health-resources-specifically-for-the-lgbtqi-community): LGBTQI-specific mental health resources including CenterLink and APA (bilingual)
- [I don't live in the U.S. Is there a NAMI program in my country?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/102-i-don-t-live-in-the-u-s-is-there-a-nami-program-in-my-country): International mental health resources for non-U.S. locations

## Legal Rights & Advocacy

- [Siento que se me discrimina en el acceso a la vivienda debido a mi condición de salud mental. ¿Cuáles son mis derechos? / I feel I am being discriminated against access to housing because of my mental illness. What are my rights?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/351-siento-que-se-me-discrimina-en-el-acceso-a-la-vivienda-debido-a-mi-condicion-de-salud-mental-cuales-son-mis-derechos-i-feel-i-am-being-discriminated-against-access-to-housing-because-of-my-mental-illness-what-are-my-rights): Housing discrimination rights and HUD complaint resources (bilingual)
- [I need an attorney – Where can I find legal help?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/35-i-need-an-attorney-where-can-i-find-legal-help): Legal aid resources and attorney referral services for mental health issues
- [How do I file a complaint against my psychiatrist/psychotherapist?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/100-how-do-i-file-a-complaint-against-my-psychiatrist-psychotherapist): Process for filing complaints against mental health professionals
- [¿Cómo puedo participar en la defensa de la salud mental? / How can I get involved to advocate on behalf of mental health?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/340-como-puedo-participar-en-la-defensa-de-la-salud-mental-how-can-i-get-involved-to-advocate-on-behalf-of-mental-health): Mental health advocacy resources including NAMI Smarts For Advocacy (bilingual)
- [Where can I get help finding a job?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/115-where-can-i-get-help-finding-a-job): Employment resources including vocational rehab and disability job placement

## NAMI Member Services

- [¿Cómo puedo hacerme miembro de NAMI? Tengo preguntas sobre la afiliación. / How do I become a NAMI member? I have membership questions.](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/371-como-puedo-hacerme-socio-de-nami-tengo-dudas-sobre-la-afiliacion-how-do-i-become-a-nami-member-i-have-membership-questions): NAMI membership information and member services contact (bilingual)
- [I'd like to fundraise for NAMI. How can I do this?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/83-i-d-like-to-fundraise-for-nami-how-can-i-do-this): Guide to fundraising events and campaigns for NAMI
- [How do I login to NAMI Net (formerly the Extranet)?](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/101-how-do-i-login-to-nami-net-formerly-the-extranet): Login instructions for NAMI Net member portal access
- [Me gustaría ser retirado de la lista de correo de NAMI. / I'd like to be removed from NAMI's mailing list.](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org/article/403-me-gustaria-ser-retirado-de-la-lista-de-correo-de-nami-id-like-to-be-removed-from-namis-mailing-list): Instructions to unsubscribe from NAMI mailing list (bilingual)
